item.goety_outlands.spellweaver_robe.inf: Allows Magic-school servants to heal themselves using their owner’s Soul Energy.
Halves the casting time of Magic spells.
item.goety_outlands.wilden_hunt_focus.in: Summons 1–2 Wilden Hunters, or 4 with the Spellweaver’s Staff (limit: 8). Cast while crouching to recall your hunters.
item.goety_outlands.wilden_stalker_focus: Summons 1–2 Wilden Stalkers, or 4 with the Spellweaver’s Staff (limit: 12). Cast while crouching to recall your stalkers.
item.goety_outlands.wilden_guardian_focu: Summons 1–2 Wilden Defenders, or 2 with the Spellweaver’s Staff (limit: 8). Cast while crouching to recall your defenders.
config.goety_outlands.necromancers.baseH: Maximum health at level 0. Levels 1 and 2 use 1.25 and 2.5 times this value, up to the health attribute cap.
config.goety_outlands.necromancers.baseA: Damage per normal projectile before rank and other bonuses. Does not affect player spells or summoned minions.
config.goety_outlands.necromancers.summo: Limits new bindings and revivals for this servant type. Lowering the limit does not remove existing servants.
config.goety_outlands.necromancers.serve: Edits the local config. Multiplayer uses the server's settings.
